Description
Carmel Catholic High School is a four-time recipient of the National Blue Ribbon School of Excellence Award and offers students incredible resources, including 130+ AP, Honors, and Dual Credit courses, as well as a world-championship winning Varsity Robotics Team, Project Lead the Way engineering program with Aerospace Engineering offerings and a unique Business INCubator Lab, where students create their own businesses and products through entrepreneurship courses. The school also has a robust fine and performing arts program - including a professional-level dance company, expansive STEM offerings with an Astronomy program taught by a NASA ambassador, and Dual Credit courses offered through three universities, including the Milwaukee School of Engineering, one of the U.S.'s top engineering programs.
